triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: weighed down by all the hideous horror of his struggle with his own father for this woman, he was incapable of imagining any danger more terrible

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: After parting from his brother on that night, he had felt in his frenzy that it would be better

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: terrible as it was to him to lose sight of Grushenka for a moment.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: Though Grushenka had, it is true, loved him for an hour, genuinely and sincerely, yet she tortured him sometimes cruelly and mercilessly.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: weighed down by all the hideous horror of his struggle with his own father for this woman, he was incapable of imagining any danger more terrible

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: for the money of Katerina Ivanovna that he had dishonestly appropriated.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: on the evening when Grushenka had insulted Katerina Ivanovna, and Mitya, after hearing Alyosha’s account of it, had admitted that he was a scoundrel

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: For him the whole tormenting question lay between him and Fyodor Pavlovitch.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: my disputes with my father, Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, who robbed me of my inheritance from my mother

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: my disputes with my father, Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, who robbed me of my inheritance from my mother

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: he had gathered further that the old man would perhaps prefer him to Fyodor Pavlovitch for Grushenka.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: In fact, he might reckon on an additional sum of six or even seven thousand roubles from Fyodor Pavlovitch

triples.subject: Lyagavy
triples.quote: Now he’s come back again and is staying with the priest at Ilyinskoe, about twelve versts from the Volovya station.

triples.subject: Lyagavy
triples.quote: He’s been haggling with Fyodor Pavlovitch for the last year, over your copse at Tchermashnya. They can’t agree on the price, maybe you’ve heard?

triples.subject: Kuzma Kuzmitch Samsonov
triples.quote: or his jealousy of Grushenka, in whose name this “scapegrace” had rushed in on him with such a tale to get money which worked on the old man, I can’t tell.
